acceptable_variants: Optional argument handling may be attached to the call or expressed with branches, provided absent arguments are actually omitted when required.
YYYY-MM-DD may remain verbatim as a constraint on the search call without an invented parser or validation step.
Different result names are acceptable when items and total still refer to the same search response.

The supplied query.yaml is a fixed statement of the same missing-argument requirements; preserve those requirements without adding a runtime configuration read solely because they are presented in YAML.
open_questions: The request does not define handling of malformed dates or explicit nulls; do not silently invent either policy.
